ruby_only_reason: no Rust binary to hold it to: the corpus-owned domain spec/corpus/semantics/domains/tally has no `tally` feature in rust/Cargo.toml, so bin/project_rust has never generated it (marked ruby_only when the domain was added, #472). The kernel does implement C3.4 (a non-finite sum is a Fault, arithmetic.rs); unverified end to end.
note: A Float is finite (C3.4). Weigh 1e308 is accepted; a second Weigh 1e308 evaluates a given whose sum is not finite — a FAULT, before any effect, leaving the weight at 1e308 (C8.1). Both runtimes' doubles would have answered Infinity; the language does not.

refusals.error: addition overflowed: 1.0e+308 + 1.0e+308 is not a finite number
